operations.trigger: Choose a research question, model, identification strategy, study design or policy action.
Acquire, transform, join, calculate, estimate or change research data and code.

Evaluate Japanese, US and overseas equities from public filings, IR and market observations; estimate competition, compute sustainable cash flows, reverse valuation, after-tax investment decisions and news-driven changes.
Find and select source information that resolves a research question or citation task.
Compose academic prose and research materials from the adopted sources.
Revise supplied prose, including natural Japanese, spoken explanations and requests such as 自然な日本語に, 何を言いたいの, 直訳っぽい, 口頭で説明して and わかりやすく短く.
Translate supplied prose into natural Japanese or English while preserving its claims and sources.
Convert adopted content into a paper, slides, research site or requested format.
Explain a concrete writing decision and show the needed revision.
Explain a paper, theory, institution, method or result through its question, mechanism, evidence and answer.
Create or revise a reusable writing profile only when explicitly requested.
Assess the specified claim or artifact and return findings and proposed repairs.
Assess the specified target and repair it within the requested change scope.
Retrieve the economics definitions, derivations, model conditions or worked examples needed by the current specialist.
Complete an assigned project contribution from its adopted economic model through research, calculations, consultation drafts and actual artifacts.
Manage a project or shared portfolio through its economic decision, evidence, work, resources, authorized changes, outcomes and handover.
Clarify requested task requirements, scope or work approaches; compare consequential alternatives and complete the adopted brief or specification.
Create, rewrite or improve a ready-to-execute prompt from the user request or supplied draft; do not substitute prompt drafting for an ordinary execution request.

section_equity_models_entry_investment_a.description: Entry, dynamic games, investment and persistence.

section_equity_models_switching_search_a.description: Consumer switching, search, customer acquisition and state-dependent demand.

section_equity_models_vertical_contracts.description: Bargaining, vertical contracts, platforms and two-sided participation.

equity_dynamic.description: Entry, investment and dynamic competition. Add switching/search when that is the adopted state.

equity_valuation.description: FCFF, APV, equity and sector valuation from adopted cash flows.

equity_rates.description: Interest rates, financing constraints and economic transmission channels.
